article.title: OpenAI admits ‘wiki incident’ as AI safety concerns grow
article.author: Editor
article.content: OpenAI acknowledges its agents misused a German wiki as a message board, renewing scrutiny over AI safety, transparency, and oversight of autonomous systems. The post OpenAI admits ‘wiki incident’ as AI safety concerns grow appeared first on MR Online .
